title: Pure Paladin of Dragon
summary: Pure Paladin of Dragon (and Knight of Dragon) Level 4 Ritual toolbox, powered by Pre-Preparation of Rites and iconic high-Level Dragon bosses. Each Level 4 Paladin Ritual Monster specifically pairs with a named Ritual Spell, destroys specific battle positions on attack, and Tributes itself to cheat out massive Dragons directly from your hand or Deck for Rank 8 Xyz and Link plays.

summary.title: Starters
points: Pre-Preparation of Rites adds both a Paladin Ritual Spell and its specifically named Level 4 Paladin/Knight Ritual Monster simultaneously from Deck to hand.
Preparation of Rites adds any Level 4 Paladin/Knight Ritual Monster from Deck to hand and can recycle a Ritual Spell from your GY.
Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands searches either a Ritual Monster or Ritual Spell upon Normal Summon and acts as the exact Level 4 Tribute material.

summary.title: Opening: Pre-Preparation + Manju
steps: Normal Summon Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands to search Luminous Dragon Ritual or Paladin of Photon Dragon from your Deck.
Activate Pre-Preparation of Rites, searching Dark Dragon Ritual and Paladin of Dark Dragon simultaneously.
Activate Dark Dragon Ritual, Tributing Manju on the field to Ritual Summon Paladin of Dark Dragon.
Activate Paladin of Dark Dragon's effect, Tributing itself to Special Summon Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon directly from your Deck.
Activate Darkness Metal Dragon's effect to revive Paladin of Dark Dragon from your GY.
Link both into Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres, or use additional Ritual Spells to field Level 8 Dragons for Rank 8 Xyz Summons.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy overlays using two Level 8 Dragons (Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon, or Blue-Eyes Jet Dragon) to negate a Spell Card or effect and redirect attacks.
Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord provides Quick Effect monster negation and destruction while holding a Photon material, and protects cards from destruction.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres Tributes a monster to bounce an opponent's face-up card without targeting, then Special Summons a Dragon from the Deck.
Blue-Eyes Jet Dragon shields all other cards you control from effect destruction and bounces an opponent's card at the start of the Damage Step.
Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon repeatedly revives Dragons from your GY each turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Pre-Preparation of Rites and Preparation of Rites give incredible search consistency for every Ritual piece.
Dark Dragon Ritual Ritual Summons Paladin of Dark Dragon and banishes itself from the GY to search a Red-Eyes card.
Luminous Dragon Ritual Ritual Summons Paladin of Photon Dragon and can banish itself from the GY to summon from the hand.
White Dragon Ritual and Armor Dragon Ritual enable instant searches and summon their respective Paladins.

allow.Pre-Preparation of Rites: Because White Dragon Ritual, Dark Dragon Ritual, Luminous Dragon Ritual, and Armor Dragon Ritual all explicitly name their exact Level 4 Paladin/Knight Ritual Monster in their text, Pre-Preparation of Rites searches BOTH the Ritual Spell and the Paladin/Knight from your Deck simultaneously!
allow.Preparation of Rites: Every single Paladin/Knight of Dragon Ritual Monster is Level 4—meaning Preparation of Rites searches ANY of them from your Deck and recovers a Ritual Spell from your GY!
allow.Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands: Level 4 LIGHT Fairy that searches any Paladin/Knight Ritual Monster or Ritual Spell on Normal Summon, then can be Tributed to Ritual Summon that Level 4 Paladin!
allow.Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon: Level 10 Red-Eyes Dragon that can be Special Summoned directly from your Deck or hand by Tributing Paladin of Dark Dragon (which summons ANY 'Red-Eyes' monster from your hand or Deck!), and revives another Dragon from your GY!
allow.Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon: Summoned directly from your hand or Deck by Tributing Paladin of Photon Dragon!
allow.Blue-Eyes White Dragon: Summoned directly from your hand or Deck by Tributing Paladin of White Dragon!
allow.Blue-Eyes Jet Dragon: Special Summons itself from hand/GY when a card is destroyed while Blue-Eyes White Dragon is on your field/GY, or summoned directly from your Deck by Tributing Paladin of White Dragon!
allow.Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic: Rank 8 Dragon Xyz summoned using Blue-Eyes White Dragon + Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon (both summoned from your Deck by Tributing your Paladins!).
allow.Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres: Link-2 Dragon summoned using any two Dragons cheated out by your Paladins.
allow.Number 90: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Lord: Rank 8 LIGHT disruption boss that negates monster effects and protects against destruction.

main: Paladin of Photon Dragon

Level 4 LIGHT Warrior Ritual Monster (1900 ATK): tributes itself to Special Summon 1 'Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon' from your hand or Deck, and draws 1 card whenever it destroys an opponent's monster by battle.
Paladin of Dark Dragon

Level 4 DARK Dragon Ritual Monster (1900 ATK): tributes itself to Special Summon ANY 'Red-Eyes' monster (including Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon!) directly from your hand or Deck, and destroys Defense Position monsters at the start of the Damage Step.
Paladin of White Dragon

Classic Level 4 LIGHT Dragon Ritual Monster (1900 ATK): tributes itself to Special Summon 1 'Blue-Eyes' monster (Blue-Eyes White Dragon or Blue-Eyes Jet Dragon!) from your hand or Deck, and destroys face-down Defense Position monsters at the start of the Damage Step.
Knight of Armor Dragon

Level 4 WIND Wyrm Ritual Monster (1900 ATK): shuffles any monster Special Summoned from the Extra Deck back into the Extra Deck at the start of the Damage Step, and tributes itself to Special Summon a Level 5 or higher WIND Dragon from your hand or Deck.
Luminous Dragon Ritual
Ritual Summons 'Paladin of Photon Dragon' by Tributing monsters from hand/field; and can banish itself + monsters from your GY to Ritual Summon Paladin of Photon Dragon from your hand!
Dark Dragon Ritual
Ritual Summons 'Paladin of Dark Dragon'; during your Main Phase (except the turn it was sent to the GY), banishes itself from your GY to add ANY 'Red-Eyes' Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand!
White Dragon Ritual
Ritual Summons 'Paladin of White Dragon' (enabling Pre-Preparation of Rites!).
Armor Dragon Ritual
Ritual Summons 'Knight of Armor Dragon'; banishes itself + monsters from your GY to Special Summon a Level 5+ WIND Dragon from your Deck.
Red-Eyes Darkness Metal Dragon
Summoned directly from your Deck by Tributing Paladin of Dark Dragon, then immediately revives another Dragon from your GY!
Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon
3000 ATK Level 8 Dragon summoned directly from your Deck by Tributing Paladin of Photon Dragon.
Blue-Eyes White Dragon
3000 ATK Level 8 Dragon summoned directly from your Deck by Tributing Paladin of White Dragon.
Blue-Eyes Jet Dragon
3000 ATK Level 8 'Blue-Eyes' Dragon summoned from your Deck by Tributing Paladin of White Dragon that protects all other cards you control from being destroyed by opponent's card effects!
Pre-Preparation of Rites
Core consistency engine: searches ANY of the 4 Ritual Spells AND its matching Level 4 Paladin/Knight Ritual Monster from your Deck or GY simultaneously!
Preparation of Rites
Searches any Level 4 Paladin/Knight of Dragon Ritual Monster from your Deck and recovers a Ritual Spell from your GY.
Manju of the Ten Thousand Hands
Searches a missing Ritual piece on Normal Summon and serves as the exact Level 4 Tribute to summon your Paladins!
extra: Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy
Rank 8 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 8 monsters: Galaxy-Eyes Photon Dragon, Blue-Eyes White Dragon, or Blue-Eyes Jet Dragon summoned by your Paladins!) that negates Spells and redirects attacks.
Hieratic Seal of the Heavenly Spheres
Link-2 Dragon made with any two Dragons summoned by your Paladins that bounces a face-up card on the opponent's turn and summons another Dragon from your Deck.
Rank 8: negates an opponent's monster effect and destroys it if a Photon card is attached; searches Photon/Galaxy cards.
